newsitem.title: USA: Tiffany holiday net sales worldwide rise.
newsitem.headline: Tiffany holiday net sales worldwide rise.

text.p: Tiffany & Co said Thursday that its worldwide net sales in the November 1 to December 31 holiday season rose 15 percent over 1995 sales.

The company said sales were led by strong performance in the United States and Japan, its two largest markets. U.S. retail sales in the season rose 13 percent from the prior year, the company said, and retail sales in Japan rose 20 percent when translated into U.S. dollars.
The company said direct marketing sales rose 12 percent and international retail sales were up 17 percent.
